reconcile.note: Gill totals the seven years as three already elapsed under Saul plus the current barren year plus three more now proposed by Gad.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells reads the two figures at face value, noting the same prophet delivers seven years of famine in Samuel against three in Chronicles.

sides.snippet: Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you?
sides.verseText: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said to him, Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? or shall there be three days' pestilence in your land? now advise you, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.

sides.snippet: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes… or else three days the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land…
sides.verseText: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and the angel of Yahweh destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.
